shots.full: Keep the reference photograph exactly as it is: the same diner kitchen, the same cook at the grill, the same man at the back, the same camera position, framing, lens, focus and light. Add Denise on the right, behind the counter by the toaster, seen from the chest up and side-on, leaning one hip on the counter edge and watching the cook work with a flat, tired face. The yellow plastic jug stays in the near foreground in front of her, soft. Light on her: the same warm overhead kitchen light as the cook, from above and behind, her face half in shadow. An unretouched photograph with the same soft focus, grain and colour as the reference. 16:9. Thanks.

Keep the first reference photograph exactly as it is: the same night street, the same lit sign reading CHICKENS WANTED MUST LAY 12 EGGS PER DAY and BETH'S CAFE, the same red neon, the same camera position, framing, lens and light. Add Barry in the lower left, in front of the dark building, seen from the chest up and turned three-quarters away, head tipped back, looking up at the sign. Light on him: only the white glow of the sign from above and to the right, catching his forehead, nose and one shoulder; the rest of him falls into the night. Barry is dressed exactly as in his portrait reference. An unretouched photograph with the same grain and colour as the reference. 16:9. Thanks.
